dedupe_keys.name: hydrologic scenarios of the main nile tributaries

description: The AWESOME project publishes monthly future streamflow ensembles for the Blue Nile, White Nile, Dinder-Rahad and Tekeze-Atbara tributaries. Zenodo lists twelve public CSV files, one for each tributary and RCP2.6, RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 combination, under CC BY 4.0. Its description says each file contains 100 realisations, with columns running from January 2007 to December 2100 in cubic metres per second. The scenarios derive from climate-driven HBV runoff and perturbations to the timing and magnitude of extremes. A modeller could use these series to test reservoir operations, flood protection, hydropower output or irrigation supply under uncertain inflows. They are generated scenarios, not observed gauge histories or probability-calibrated forecasts. The page does not provide the detailed perturbation distributions or verify correlation among tributaries. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Nile ensemble files. The CSV contents were not downloaded, so row counts and date headers remain unchecked.
name: Hydrologic scenarios of the main Nile tributaries
